description: This file defines the MergeSortedAsPair class, an Akka Streams GraphStage that merges two sorted streams into pairs of elements, delivering the pair before final comparison, with support for custom comparators and maximal elements.

classes.name: MergeSortedAsPair
classes.description: A final class extending GraphStage that merges two sorted streams into pairs, with customizable comparison and maximal element handling.

classes.name: MergeSortAsPairLogic
classes.description: Inner class extending AbstractDittoGraphStageLogic, implementing the logic for merging streams, handling comparisons, and managing stream completion.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Static method to merge two sources with a comparator and a maximal element, returning a Source of pairs.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to create a merge stage for comparable types or with a custom comparator, using a maximal element.

methods.name: createLogic
methods.description: Creates the GraphStageLogic for this stage.

methods.name: shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the stage, a FanInShape2 of two input streams and one output stream.
